newsitem.title: UK: Flextech dive seen a "massive overreaction".
newsitem.headline: Flextech dive seen a "massive overreaction".

text.p: Shares in British cable and satellite television company Flextech Plc dived to new year lows of 534.75p in slim trade on Wednesday but analysts said the sharp falls were "a massive overreaction".

"There's very little volume, it's clearly market-maker driven," said Sarah Simon, industry analyst at Morgan Stanley. "There's also been some stock coming into the market from Hallmark and the BBC which is going to keep the price down a little bit," she added.
By 1200 GMT, the stock had recovered some losses to trade at 546p, 14p weaker on the day.

"I think this is a massive overreaction," said Simon, who rates the stock a strong buy. "I think if they (Flextech) announce one interesting deal the shares will bounce up. It's very much a news-driven stock."
